title: Henry Martin's family
summary: Martin's mother ran the school place; his brother Kutcher played piano, and Allen hopes to trace Miss Martin.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, what about Henry's family? Did he have anybody else in the family that played music?
He had a brother they called Kutcher. He used to play piano.

He had a brother and two sisters. Yeah, he had a brother and two sisters. Two sisters. I think Ms. Martin is living yet too. The mother or the sister? No, I think they're all living. I'm more than sure Ms. Martin is living because my wife told me she saw a while back when she used to go play the Keno games. She saw Ms. Martin and one of her daughters.
I'd like to talk to her if I could find out her right name.
I'd like to see her myself. I don't know where the devil she live at.
You find her right name and I'll find her.
If I could find somebody in that neighborhood, I'd make that name.
